newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume leaps as prices fall.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume leaps as prices fall.

text.p: Prices on the Istanbul gold exchange fell on Thursday along with world trends and volume jumped to 630 kilos from 85 kilos on Tuesday, the last day of trade before the New Year holiday.

Gold closed at $368.60 an ounce, down from Tuesday's $369.90 following lower trends in world markets. Gold also fell in lira terms to 1,283,400 lira per gram from the previous 1,297,000 with the help of a firm lira.
The lira closed at 108,220 to the dollar, firming from Tuesday's 108,290 on intervention by the central bank.
Morning session volume totalled 390 kilos with 240 kilos done in the afternoon when no dollar deals were made. 76.2 percent of total trade was in lira terms.
